data.one_liner: Rename Flutter app's Android and iOS package identifiers via a single CLI command.
data.what_it_does: Updates AndroidManifest, build.gradle, MainActivity files and iOS bundle identifier to a new package name. Moves files to the new directory structure and removes the old one. Supports selective platform renaming.
use_when: You need to change the app's package/bundle identifier for rebranding or publishing under a new ID
You want an automated, one‑command way to update all related files across Android and iOS
avoid_when: Your project uses custom Gradle or Xcode configurations that the tool can't detect
You require runtime package name changes or dynamic identifiers
strengths: Handles both Android and iOS in one step
Supports latest Flutter versions and Kotlin/Java MainActivity files
Can target a single platform if needed
weaknesses: May not work with heavily customized project structures
Only updates package name; does not adjust related code references
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and run `dart run change_app_package_name:main <new.package.name>`
data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  change_app_package_name: ^1.5.0

# then run
dart run change_app_package_name:main com.example.newname --android
